test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error in phrasal verb.
Bindu asked Arya to fill out for / her so that she could / take care of / her sick father.

options.text: Bindu asked Arya to fill out for

solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Bindu asked Arya to fill out for .
